description:
List detected on-page code/HTML changes tracked by Code Monitor, newest first. Each row returns url, date, created_at (ISO), and change_types (which fields changed, e.g. Title, Canonical, Meta Description, noindex, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, H1 Heading, Status code, Hreflang, Open graph, Twitter image, Analytics, Tag manager). Filter to one monitored page with seoMonitorId (from list_code_monitor_pages) or page (its URL); omit both for the project-wide recent-changes feed — this is how you check what changed / "alerts" across the whole property. Narrow the window with from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); omit both for full history. Cursor-paginated (limit defaults to 50, max 200). Use get_code_monitor_change with the row's url + created_at for the before/after diff. Returns feature_not_available when the plan does not include Code Monitor. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Project-wide detected changes in June (the "alerts" feed).
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","from":"2026-06-01","to":"2026-06-30"}
```
name: list_code_monitor_changes
title: Code Monitor changes
